about.intro: DiceCloud is a single-developer project started in 2014 with the aim of being a character sheet that stayed in sync between the DM and their players, and made it clear where every value in the sheet came from, and how it was calculated.
about.samThanks: without her love, DiceCloud could not hope to exist
about.heroesThanks: The D&D party whose joy was the fuel powering the early versions of DiceCloud.

discord.communityText: Ask questions, share libraries and report bugs with other players.
discord.webhookTitle: Send a character's rolls to Discord
discord.webhookText: Each character can post its log (rolls, actions, rests) to a Discord channel.
discord.webhookStep1: In Discord, open the channel settings, then Integrations, Webhooks, and create a webhook.
discord.webhookStep3: On the character sheet, open the menu, Edit details, and paste the URL in the “Discord webhook URL” field.

home.tagline: Free, auditable, real-time character tracking for 5th edition
home.subtitle: Spend less time shuffling paper, and more time playing the game
home.freeText: DiceCloud is free to use, community funded, and the source code is available on Github under a GPL license.
home.customText: Add new ability scores, skills, health-bars, and stats to your character. The entire sheet is under your control.
home.engineText: Characters are computed in real-time based on their equipment, features, and buffs.
home.community: Get involved in the DiceCloud community
home.tableText: The party board shows the game master every character's hit points and conditions, the initiative order and whose turn it is, live as the players roll.

action.name: Action
action.helpText: Actions are things your character can do. When an action is taken, all the properties under it are activated.

attribute.name: Attribute
attribute.helpText: Attributes are the numbered statistics of your character, excluding rolls you might add proficiency bonus to, those are skills.

adjustment.name: Attribute damage
adjustment.helpText: Attribute damage reduces the current value of an attribute when it is applied by an action. A negative value causes the attribute to increase instead, up to its normal maximum.

buff.name: Buff
buff.helpText: When a buff is activated as a child of an action, it will copy the properties under itself onto a target character.

buffRemover.name: Remove buff
buffRemover.helpText: Removes a buff from the target character

branch.name: Branch
branch.helpText: When a branch is activated as a child of an action, it can control which of its children get activated.

class.name: Class
class.helpText: Your character should ideally have one starting class. Classes hold class levels

classLevel.name: Class level
classLevel.helpText: Class levels represent a single level gained in a class

constant.name: Constant
constant.helpText: A constant can define a static value that can be used in calculations elsewhere in the sheet

container.name: Container
container.helpText: A container holds items in the inventory

creature.name: Creature
creature.helpText: A creature is a template for a creature that might become a real creature once summoned by a character

damage.name: Damage
damage.helpText: When damage is activated by an action it reduces the hit points of the target creature by the calculated amount.

effect.name: Effect
effect.helpText: Effects change the value or state of attributes and skills.

feature.name: Feature
feature.helpText: Descriptive or narrative features your character has access to

folder.name: Folder
folder.helpText: A way to organise other properties on the character

item.name: Item
item.helpText: Objects and equipment your charcter finds on their adventures

note.name: Note
note.helpText: Notes about your character and their adventures

pointBuy.name: Point buy
pointBuy.helpText: A point buy table that allows the user to select an array of values that match a given cost

proficiency.name: Proficiency
proficiency.helpText: Proficiencies apply your proficiency bonus to skills already on your character sheet.

roll.name: Roll
roll.helpText: When activated by an action, rolls perform a calculation and temporarily store the result for other properties under the same action to use

reference.name: Reference
reference.helpText: A reference is a link to a different property in a library. When a reference gets copied to a character sheet, it is replaced with the referenced property and all its children.

savingThrow.name: Saving throw
savingThrow.helpText: When a saving throw is activated by an action, it causes the target to make a saving throw, if the saving throw fails, the children properties of the saving throw are activated.

skill.name: Skill
skill.helpText: Skills, saves, languages, and weapon and tool proficiencies are all skills. Skills can have a default proficiency set. Proficiencies and effects can change the value and state of skills.

propertySlot.name: Slot
propertySlot.helpText: A slot in the character sheet is used to specify that a property needs to be selected from a library to fill the slot. The slot can determine what tags it is looking for, and any subscribed library property with matching tags can fill the slot

spellList.name: Spell list
spellList.helpText: A list of spells on your character sheet. It can provide a DC and spell attack bonus to the spells within

spell.name: Spell
spell.helpText: A spell your character can potentially cast

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.helpText: Togggles allow parts of the character sheet to be turned on and off, either manually or as the result of a calculation.

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.helpText: Triggers apply their children in response to events on the character sheet, such as taking an action or receiving damage

emptyTabs.inventoryText: Your class and background give your starting equipment. Add items or containers yourself with the + button.
